_meta.title: Numbers — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Numbers (the Aaronic blessing, God's faithfulness and power, the bronze serpent). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 4 Numbers); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; census/law/travelogue chapters largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.plain: The Lord bless you and keep you;

verses.text: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.plain: the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;

verses.text: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.plain: the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.plain: The Lord answered Moses, 'Is the Lord's arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you.'

verses.text: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.plain: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.plain: The Lord said to Moses, 'Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live.'

verses.text: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.plain: God is not human, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?
